title: Auth refresh coordination is only per tab and session UX does not signal cross-device revocation

original_titles.title: No Web Locks / BroadcastChannel serialization of refresh across tabs
No cross-tab refresh coordination (Web Locks / BroadcastChannel)
Sessions: no approximate location, no 'sign out other sessions', no session-revoked notice/state clear
Session list lacks location; no session_revoked handling (ATH-05a S3)
Session-expired UX (P-23) and 'signed in on another device' variant missing

problem: frontend/src/lib/api.ts shares one refresh promise inside a single JS runtime. There is no Web Locks/BroadcastChannel coordination across tabs. Account UI lists/revokes a specific session but has no revoke-all operation or cross-device session-revoked notification; it exposes a truncated user-agent, not approximate device location.
impact: Multiple tabs can concurrently rotate the same refresh token family, and a session revoked elsewhere may leave the other tab displaying stale authenticated state until its next request.

verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Use Web Locks (with a fallback BroadcastChannel protocol) to serialize refresh rotation across tabs. Broadcast refresh success, logout, session revocation and expiry events without broadcasting bearer tokens.
On receiving a revocation event, clear in-memory access token and query cache, redirect to login and preserve only non-sensitive locally saved drafts.
Add a server-side revoke-all-other-sessions endpoint scoped to the current user, with explicit confirmation and refresh-token-family revocation.
If approximate location is added, derive it server-side from privacy-minimized IP metadata and disclose retention; do not expose raw IP addresses to participants.
Add multi-tab tests with simultaneous 401s, one tab logout, password reset and server-side session revocation.

acceptance_criteria: Two tabs do not race refresh rotation.
Revocation is reflected in every open tab promptly.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.
